description: Sanitized planning hints for an inbound appointment and receiving scenario. These hints require evidence before becoming configuration instructions.

task_hints.goal: Confirm the receiving flow, site scope, and target environment before selecting configuration details.
evidence_requirements: Product-version documentation describing the supported inbound receiving flow

task_hints.goal: Define the required appointment capacity behavior without assuming product-specific keys or values.
evidence_requirements: Version-matched documentation for appointment capacity and schedule behavior

task_hints.goal: Identify integration touchpoints affected by the appointment and receiving design.
evidence_requirements: Documentation for the confirmed integration interfaces and receiving event flow

task_hints.goal: Validate the planned appointment-to-receiving flow and its rollback boundaries.
evidence_requirements: Documented validation and rollback guidance for each planned configuration area
